name: rate-limits
description: Writes the account's rate-limit windows (five_hour, seven_day) to ~/.claude/local/rate-limits.json on every measurement, for the weekly readout fleet-launch.sh prints before dispatching, and keeps a per-session history of every window move for fleet-metrics.py's peak 5-hour reading

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Write the reading on every measurement that carries one. Off writes nothing.
